title: State and Union Territory forest and tree cover — ISFR 2023
description: Official state/UT aggregates from the parliamentary reply citing Forest Survey of India ISFR 2023. This dataset is state/UT-level only and does not supply current district estimates.

source.title: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change — Parliamentary Question: Steps To Bring More Area Under Green Cover (Rajya Sabha US Q367), table based on ISFR 2023
source.note: Areas are km². Forest cover and tree cover are separate measures; do not describe their sum as forest cover alone. Ladakh's row gives forest cover, tree cover and combined total but no geographical-area figure.
